title: Draft Guidance on Regulatory Principles for Model Risk Management, 2026
summary: On 24 June 2026 the Reserve Bank of India released draft guidance on model risk management for 11 categories of regulated entities, including commercial, small finance, payments, regional rural and co-operative banks, all-India financial institutions, NBFCs, asset reconstruction companies and credit information companies. It covers every model these entities use, including AI/ML models and models from third parties. It would require a board-approved model risk framework, model risk appetite and tiering, and human oversight of AI models with override or deactivation arrangements. The RBI cites the FREE-AI committee report as background. Comments were due by 24 July 2026; no final version was found as of 26 October 2026.
key_obligations: Maintain a board-approved model risk management framework (proposed)
Apply model risk controls to AI/ML and third-party models (proposed)
Keep human oversight of AI models, including kill-switch arrangements (proposed)
